result.instructions: Tools for Teamgate, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Teamgate data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run teamgate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teamgate_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teamgate_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. teamgate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teamgate_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the Teamgate users of the account with id, name and username. Use the ids as owner_id filters and values. GET /users.

name.description: Part of the user's first name.

is_active.description: Only active (true) or only inactive (false) users.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: teamgate_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One Teamgate user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: teamgate_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List or search leads (unqualified prospects) with owner, status, source, industry and contact details. Filter by name, email, phone, status, owner, source, star or creation date. GET /leads.

email.description: Part of an email address (at least 3 characters).

phone.description: The last digits of a phone number (at least 3 characters).

status.description: Exact lead status name, e.g. 'New'. See teamgate_list_lead_statuses.

owner_id.description: Only leads owned by this user id.

starred.description: Only starred (true) or not starred (false) leads.

created_after.description: Only leads created at or after this RFC 3339 date or date-time.

created_before.description: Only leads created at or before this RFC 3339 date or date-time.

include_custom_fields.description: Include custom field values in the reply (default false).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: teamgate_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a lead. Give a person's name, or a company_name for a company lead. Teamgate may start workflows or notifications for new leads. POST /leads.

name.description: Person's full name (required unless company_name is given).

company_name.description: Company name for a company lead (required unless name is given).

job_title.description: Job title (used only together with company_name).

status.description: Lead status name, e.g. 'New' (created if it does not exist).

source.description: Source name (created if it does not exist).

industry.description: Industry name (created if it does not exist).

tags.description: Tags to set on the record.

tools.name: teamgate_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one lead. Only the fields you pass are sent; this overwrites their current values. PUT /leads/{id}.

source.description: Source name (created if it does not exist).

industry.description: Industry name (created if it does not exist).

tags.description: Tags to set on the record.
